title: Madd - līn letters
description: Rules pertaining to the madd in the letters of līn (و sākin preceeded by a fatḥah & ي preceeded by a fatḥah).

lin_followed_by_hamza_in_same_word_warsh.title: Tawassuṭ/Ṭūl on līn when followed by a hamzah in the same word
lin_followed_by_hamza_in_same_word_warsh.description: Imam Warsh has the option to make the madd either tawassuṭ or ṭūl when a letter of līn is followed by a hamzah in the same word.
exceptions: In the words الْمَوْؤُودَةُ and مَوْئِلًا Imam Warsh will only apply qaṣr.

The word سَوْآت has a madd lin followed by a madd badal. This particular word has 4 permissble ways to be read according to Imam Warsh these are: • Reading qaṣr on سَوْ and qaṣr/tawassuṭ/ṭūl on the madd badal in آت • Reading tawassuṭ on سَوْ and tawassuṭ on the madd badal in آت

examples.verse: examples of madd lin for warsh

lin_followed_by_hamza_in_same_word_warsh.note: If the hamzah is in the next word, Imam Warsh will make naql will instead of madd

lin_followed_by_hamza_in_same_word_qasr.title: Qaṣr on līn when followed by a hamzah in the same word
lin_followed_by_hamza_in_same_word_qasr.description: All of the qurra other than Imam Warsh will recite the madd on a letter of līn that is followed by a hamza in the same word with qaṣr

madd_lin_arid.title: Madd Līn ʿĀriḍ
madd_lin_arid.description: If a letter of līn is followed by a sukūn of waqf then all 3 madd lengths are permissible

lin_followed_by_other_than_hamza.title: Qaṣr on līn when followed by any letter other than hamzah
lin_followed_by_other_than_hamza.description: All of the qurra  will recite the madd on a letter of līn that is followed by other than a hamzah with qaṣr

examples.verse: examples of madd lin followed by other than hamza
